text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace won the Osaka Hai. That 
brilliant run served as a major turning 
point in changing how the public saw her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace fought her way to the top 
with pure grit and determination. Inspired 
by her relentless spirit, more and more 
fans are beginning to cheer her on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A victory in her next race, the Takarazuka 
Kinen, would cement Katsuragi Ace's 
reputation. The Trainer braced himself and 
tightened his focus even further!
